name: best_vary_iters_initial
description: Best-spot isolate. Everything fixed at the winning regime (radius 0.12, sel_sigma 0.2, n_select 100, mix_ratio 0.5, Weakpoint distance, top-3 detectors); sweeps ONLY initial training time to map how an under- vs over-trained initial model changes the guided-vs-baseline gap. 10 iters_initial x 3 seeds = 30 configs.
